model_name: Nested Linear Mixed Model for GDP Prediction

algorithm.name: Linear Mixed Effects Model
algorithm.citation:
Bates, D., Mächler, M., Bolker, B., & Walker, S. (2015). 
    Fitting Linear Mixed-Effects Models Using lme4. 
    Journal of Statistical Software, 67(1), 1-48.

training_data.name: European GDP and Illicit Drug Concentrations in Wastewater
training_data.description:
Dataset combining GDP, year, and drug metabolite
    concentrations (amphetamine, methamphetamine, cocaine, MDMA)
    from multiple European regions
preprocessing: Removed cannabis and ketamine due to NAs

hyperparameters.formula:
gdp ~ ref_year + mdma + amphetamine + 
                cocaine + methamphetamine + (1 | nuts_code)

intended_use.purpose: Estimate GDP with nested random effects for geographic regions
intended_use.scope: European NUTS code regions with nested structure
constraints: Assumes random intercepts capture between-region variation
Requires sufficient number of NUTS code groups (>5 recommended)
Fixed effects assume no cross-level interactions

known_limitations:
Imperfect estimation of population in catchment area of wastewater 
    treatment plants, especially during events
Imperfect mapping between data sources via manual mapping
Assumes normally distributed random effects and residuals
Limited to random intercepts only (no random slopes)
May be computationally intensive with many NUTS code levels
Allows new levels during prediction but at reduced accuracy
Sensitive to scaling of continuous predictors

technical_specs.output_type:
numeric (continuous GDP values, 
                   accounting for group-level variation)

fair4ml_compliance.findable:
Metadata included in RO-Crate with DOI reference,
    public dataset and code.
fair4ml_compliance.accessible: Model and metadata deposited in TUWRD (T3.9)
fair4ml_compliance.interoperable: Standard JSON format, referenced dataset DOI
fair4ml_compliance.reusable:
Clear license, public repository including all code and
         documentation, intended use, limitations documented,
         parameters documented, seeds and randomness controlled.
